flags.model_excerpt: వాట్సాప్లో నెంబర్ ఇస్తే ఫస్ట్ వీడియో కాల్ చేస్తా
flags.model_translation: If you give your number on WhatsApp, I will video call first.
flags.model_justification: The expert is proposing to move the conversation to an external app (WhatsApp).
flags.model_context: The expert suggests moving to WhatsApp to video call. The user agrees to provide the number.

flags.model_translation: If you pay 300, I will start.
flags.model_justification: The expert is asking for money in exchange for a service, which is a strong case for suspicious activity.
flags.model_context: The expert asks for a payment of 300 to start the service. The user agrees and asks for the number.

flags.model_excerpt: డబల్ సెవెన్ ఎయిట్ జీరో డబల్ సెవెన్ ఎయిట్ జీరో టూ సిక్స్ ఫోర్
flags.model_justification: The user is sharing their phone number to move the conversation outside the app.
flags.model_context: The user provides their phone number to the expert. The expert starts repeating it back.

flags.model_excerpt: టూ సిక్స్ ఫోర్ వన్ ఫోర్ త్రీ
flags.model_justification: The user is providing the remainder of their phone number to facilitate moving to an external app.
flags.model_context: The user continues providing the rest of the phone number. The expert notes that it is not working on WhatsApp.
